meta.title: Contact JP-Buy support
meta.description: Get help with proxy buying Japanese Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh cards. Reach the JP-Buy team on WhatsApp, email or Discord, or start a live chat.

hero.title: Contact support
hero.subtitle: Questions about an order, fees or shipping your cards to the U.S.? Reach out and our team will get back to you.

channels.title: Ways to reach us
channels.subtitle: Pick whichever channel works best for you.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
whatsapp.desc: Fastest way to reach a human. Message us for order help and quotes.

email.name: Email
email.desc: Best for detailed questions, receipts and order references.

discord.name: Discord
discord.desc: Join the JP-Buy collector community for drops, tips and live help.

liveChat.title: Chat with us
liveChat.subtitle: Live chat with the JP-Buy team is coming soon. In the meantime, reach us on WhatsApp, email or Discord.

hours.title: Support hours
hours.note: Hours run overnight U.S. time (previous evening into the next morning) because our team is based in Asia. Times shift by one hour during daylight saving. We reply to off-hours messages as soon as we're back online.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.subtitle: Quick answers before you reach out.

contact.note: Proxy purchase items may require additional domestic and international shipping fees. See the Fees page for an estimated breakdown.
